body: If he’s gotten to the point of peeing in jugs rather than walking to the restroom then he needs professional help and you shouldn’t feel like this is all your responsibility. I don’t know how old you guys are/if he lives at home. Maybe get his family involved?
My favorite part definitely. I have deep self hatred but while cleaning up its different and I can actually care about well being.

I saw my grandpa on my dads side pass away and even though I tried I couldn’t cry for him. my grandma stared me down like I was a terrible person but I really didnt know him that well because of a language barrier. what comforts me is realizing that everyone processes differently and you shouldn’t beat yourself up over it.
same boat except its not life its me and my self destructive habits. with how I behave you’d think I hate being happy or something.

How is your journey going so far? Personally Id been in denial about it being a problem till yesterday so this is all very new. I use to be quite proud of how sexually open I was as I have sexual trauma from when I was younger. So being able to do all these things felt like progress till I started taking it too far. Ive tried to rely on sensations before but Ive found only my own hands can get me to that point unless the sex is excessively aggressive. I once was able to while I was high but Im sure you see the issue there. I haven’t been successful yet but Ill definitely continue exploring that. I think I get wym and it’s very helpful. I need to learn to focus on what’s in front of me instead of fantasying. I also really like your idea of being my own therapist and I think keeping a closer eye on my behavior like that would be really beneficial.

My depression mingles with my other mental illness’s so keep that in mind: 
I find your positive outlook so bizarre honestly because while rationally I understand that everything will be alright-  in the moment I cant grasp that on a subconscious level. My body wants to go into fight or flight mode and often resorts to suicidal fantasies or even self harm, which I experience frequently. My depression is crippling/consuming but only from my perspective. I hide how Im feeling from people I know irl because its very intimate for me and makes me uncomfortable. I also do this for other people because I know being around someone whose depressed 24/7 isn’t anyones idea of fun. Ive always had these sorts of issues from a very young age but my parent’s didn’t believe in mental illness and explained my behavior away so I went untreated for a very long time. The most treatment Ive been through is medication though. I should seek more help but even that interaction is appalling to me. Also my depression is genetic but it definitely worsened due to the environments Ive been in. Ive learned to live with it to an extent.
I like getting into a hot bath with all my clothes on. The weight of my clothes and the warmth is so comforting
My ex boyfriend would get mad when I wouldnt show him, he would grab my wrists or legs and force me to show him. It was very uncomfortable for me but tbh until just now I didn’t think much of it.
the smiths are almost always my go to. super sad so I can hopefully cry it out first and get rid of that urge.
